title: How Is My Model Going to Function?

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: In the last video, we covered the question, where's my model going to go?
cues.zh: 上一段影片討論了模型要放在哪裡。

cues.en: And now we're covering the question, how is my model going to function?
cues.zh: 現在要談的是模型要如何運作。

cues.en: And the two main dichotomies here are online real time.
cues.zh: 這裡主要有兩種方式：線上，即時處理，

cues.en: As in would you like your predictions returned immediately or offline as in batch processing?
cues.zh: 也就是你希望立刻得到預測，還是離線，也就是批次處理？

cues.en: Is it okay for the predictions to come back later?
cues.zh: 稍後才拿到預測結果，可以接受嗎？

cues.en: So, for example, you might schedule a model to run once an hour or once a day.
cues.zh: 例如，可以排程讓模型每小時或每天執行一次。

cues.en: So let's go here and break it down online real time.
cues.zh: 我們來把線上即時處理拆開看看。

cues.en: So in the case of Food Vision Mini, we might upload pizza.
cues.zh: 以 FoodVision Mini 為例，我們可能上傳披薩照片。

cues.en: Dad, my dad give him two thumbs up with a big plate of pizza here, upload that image to Food Vision Mini and then Food Vision meaning returns that the prediction of that image is a pizza.
cues.zh: 照片中是我爸爸端著一大盤披薩，豎起兩個大拇指。把影像上傳到 FoodVision Mini，它就預測照片中的是披薩。

cues.en: Hopefully our model is good enough to do that.
cues.zh: 希望模型表現夠好，能做到這點。

cues.en: So this is real time.
cues.zh: 這就是即時處理。

cues.en: The predictions happen immediately.
cues.zh: 立刻產生預測。

cues.en: So another use case here would be if you were doing fraud transaction and you were building a machine learning model to predict whether transaction was fraud or not.
cues.zh: 另一個例子是詐欺交易偵測，建立模型來預測交易是否涉及詐欺。

cues.en: You don't want that to be waiting 10 minutes, an hour a day even.
cues.zh: 你不會想等十分鐘、一小時，甚至一天。

cues.en: You want it to be immediate.
cues.zh: 你希望立刻得到結果。

cues.en: So someone swipes their credit card or someone purchases something online and the transaction goes through pretty quickly.
cues.zh: 有人刷信用卡或在線上購物時，交易很快就能通過。

cues.en: That's an ideal use case.
cues.zh: 這就是理想的使用情境。

cues.en: The next one is offline or batch processing.
cues.zh: 下一種是離線或批次處理。

cues.en: Now the batch here stands for can typically happen with multiple samples at once.
cues.zh: 這裡的批次，通常表示可以同時處理多個樣本。

cues.en: So say we uploaded multiple images to food vision.
cues.zh: 假設我們上傳多張影像到 FoodVision

cues.en: Many.
cues.zh: Mini，

cues.en: We waited 10 minutes and then it returned back.
cues.zh: 等了十分鐘，才得到回傳結果，

cues.en: Pizza, steak and sushi.
cues.zh: 披薩、牛排和壽司。

cues.en: So in other words, the predictions come at a delay.
cues.zh: 換句話說，預測結果會延後出現。

cues.en: Now, is that an ideal use case for our food vision?
cues.zh: 對我們的 FoodVision

cues.en: Many?
cues.zh: Mini 而言，這是理想情境嗎？

cues.en: Well, I don't think so, because we don't want people waiting 10 minutes.
cues.zh: 我不這麼認為，因為我們不想讓使用者等十分鐘。

cues.en: We would rather our application to return predictions in real time.
cues.zh: 我們希望應用程式能即時回傳預測。

cues.en: But for training, this is okay.
cues.zh: 不過，訓練時這樣倒是可以。

cues.en: We could upload a thousand images or 10,000 images and then in the background they train.
cues.zh: 我們可以上傳 1,000 或 10,000 張影像，然後在背景進行訓練。

cues.en: Our model gets better.
cues.zh: 模型會進步。

cues.en: We could wait 10 minutes.
cues.zh: 我們可以等十分鐘，

cues.en: We could wait an hour maybe.
cues.zh: 也許可以等一小時。

cues.en: And then as long as the predictions are good, we might accept the fact that predictions come at a delay if our model is getting better.
cues.zh: 只要預測結果好，模型持續改善，就可能接受延後才得到結果。

cues.en: But in the case of using the actual app for inference, we would want them to happen in real time.
cues.zh: 但實際使用 app 進行推論時，我們會希望它即時完成。

cues.en: So let's keep breaking it down.
cues.zh: 繼續拆開看看。

cues.en: How is my model going to function online or offline?
cues.zh: 模型要如何運作，線上還是離線？

cues.en: So offline predictions, which is known as batch or asynchronous and online prediction, which is real time or synchronous.
cues.zh: 離線預測也稱為批次或非同步；線上預測則是即時或同步。

cues.en: We'll give two examples.
cues.zh: 我們來看兩個例子。

cues.en: First, Food Vision.
cues.zh: 首先是 FoodVision

cues.en: Many classify photos into pizza, steak and sushi online.
cues.zh: Mini，線上把照片分類成披薩、牛排或壽司。

cues.en: So the predictions come back as soon as possible or as soon as data is sent to the model, something comes back.
cues.zh: 預測會盡快回來，也就是資料一送進模型，就有結果回傳。

cues.en: Whereas a use case for offline would be Apple photos.
cues.zh: 離線的一個使用情境則是 Apple 照片。

cues.en: So if you have an iPhone and you take photos on it when you plug it into charge, Apple runs or the
cues.zh: 如果你有 iPhone，並用它拍照，接上充電器時，Apple 或者說

cues.en: iPhone or the iOS runs a machine learning model to sort those photos in the background and it sorts the photos offline.
cues.zh: 手機上的 iOS，會在背景執行機器學習模型，把照片以離線方式分類整理。

cues.en: So the period here would be when it's plugged into charge, maybe for longer than an hour, it starts
cues.zh: 這裡的時機就是插著充電時，可能插了一小時以上，便開始

cues.en: to run models on the device to sort the photos into, say, beach or family or different faces.
cues.zh: 在裝置上執行模型，把照片分成海灘、家人或不同人物的臉等類別。

cues.en: Now, why would it do this?
cues.zh: 為什麼要這麼做？

cues.en: Why is this an ideal workflow?
cues.zh: 為什麼這是理想的工作流程？

cues.en: Well, let's think about it.
cues.zh: 想一想。

cues.en: If your phone was to sort photos while you were using it.
cues.zh: 如果你正在使用手機時，手機同時整理照片，

cues.en: So it's running a machine learning model in the background.
cues.zh: 也就是在背景執行機器學習模型，

cues.en: Well, that could potentially provide not ideal use case because your phone might start to slow down because it's running a machine learning model and it might start to deplete a fair bit of battery because
cues.zh: 體驗可能不理想。模型在背景運作，可能讓手機變慢，也可能消耗不少電池，因為

cues.en: it's running a machine learning model in the background.
cues.zh: 背景正在執行機器學習模型。

cues.en: So here's a good use case for offline when the phone is plugged into charge.
cues.zh: 所以，插著充電時離線執行，就是一個很好的情境。

cues.en: So that way the battery is not going to be depleted.
cues.zh: 這樣就不會耗盡電池。

cues.en: You're not using it, so you're not going to experience a slow device.
cues.zh: 你也沒有正在使用手機，所以不會感覺裝置變慢。

cues.en: And so if we have a look at this frequency for offline prediction, how often does your model run, such as every 10 minutes or every 4 hours or once per day?
cues.zh: 再看離線預測的頻率，模型多久執行一次？例如每十分鐘、每四小時，或每天一次。

cues.en: So if you're YouTube, maybe you run your recommendation algorithm once per day.
cues.zh: 如果是 YouTube，推薦演算法可能每天執行一次。

cues.en: So they probably run this a lot more, maybe once every minute, maybe even faster.
cues.zh: 實際上，他們大概執行得更頻繁，可能每分鐘一次，甚至更快。

cues.en: But they might run an offline prediction to generate recommendations for me.
cues.zh: 不過，他們可能透過離線預測，為我、

cues.en: You, everyone in the world based on the videos that were watch yesterday.
cues.zh: 你，以及世界上其他人，根據昨天觀看的影片產生推薦。

cues.en: So that's periodical whereas online predictions, they come as soon as requests come.
cues.zh: 所以那是定期處理；線上預測則是請求一來就處理。

cues.en: So as soon as data comes in, the prediction comes back as soon as possible.
cues.zh: 也就是資料一進來，就盡快回傳預測。

cues.en: Online useful for.
cues.zh: 線上適合什麼呢？

cues.en: So the offline prediction what's useful for.
cues.zh: 先看離線預測適合什麼。

cues.en: So processing slash training on data where you don't need immediate results.
cues.zh: 在不需要立刻得到結果的情況下，處理資料或用資料訓練。

cues.en: So in case of Apple photos or another photo sorting app.
cues.zh: 例如 Apple 照片，或其他照片分類 app。

cues.en: We don't need immediate results for our photos to be sorted.
cues.zh: 我們不需要照片立刻就整理好。

cues.en: But in the case of a Tesla self-driving car, well, we want our predictions to be online.
cues.zh: 但如果是特斯拉自動駕駛汽車，就會希望預測是線上的。

cues.en: We want them to happen as soon as possible, because if they don't, there might be a safety issue.
cues.zh: 我們希望它盡快完成，否則可能有安全問題。

cues.en: So optimize here for offline prediction is optimized for high throughput.
cues.zh: 所以這裡，離線預測著重最佳化的是高吞吐量。

cues.en: So our photos app could sort thousands of photos in the background.
cues.zh: 照片 app 可以在背景整理數千張照片。

cues.en: So making predictions slash training on many samples at a time.
cues.zh: 也就是一次對大量樣本進行預測或訓練。

cues.en: Whereas if we wanted to do it online, we might do it low latency.
cues.zh: 線上則可能著重低延遲。

cues.en: So we want fast and quick results and we want them often an example for each of these.
cues.zh: 我們希望結果快速，而且能頻繁取得。各自的例子，

cues.en: We've kind of spoken about this, but a recommendation engine such as Netflix or YouTube where it could generate recommendations every 10 minutes, every 4 hours or once per day, Apple photos, sorting app,
cues.zh: 剛才大致談過，例如 Netflix 或 YouTube 的推薦引擎，可能每十分鐘、每四小時或每天產生推薦；還有 Apple 照片分類 app，

cues.en: YouTube video indexing.
cues.zh: 以及 YouTube 影片索引。

cues.en: So if YouTube not only generating recommendations, but sort of going through a video and analyzing what topics are discussed, so that could happen in an offline fashion.
cues.zh: YouTube 不只是產生推薦，也可能分析影片在討論哪些主題，這就能用離線方式進行。

cues.en: And then of course, training happens in an offline matter.
cues.zh: 當然，訓練也是離線進行。

cues.en: We've trained all of our models so far in a batch style, then online prediction.
cues.zh: 目前所有模型都是以批次方式訓練。接著是線上預測。

cues.en: So food vision, many we want people to be able to upload to their device and take a photo and then have the predictions come back as soon as possible.
cues.zh: 對 FoodVision Mini，我們希望使用者能在裝置上上傳影像或拍照，並盡快拿到預測。

cues.en: Fraudulent transaction detection.
cues.zh: 還有詐欺交易偵測。

cues.en: There would be no point if we wanted to buy something at a shop and then the shopkeeper is like, Oh, just wait an hour.
cues.zh: 如果我們到商店買東西，店員卻說：「喔，請等一小時。」那就沒意義了。

cues.en: I need a machine learning model to run every hour at 9 a.m. to tell whether your credit card is fraud or not.
cues.zh: 「我要等模型執行，每小時跑一次，九點時才能知道你的信用卡是否涉及詐欺。」

cues.en: We don't want that spam detection.
cues.zh: 我們可不希望如此。還有垃圾訊息偵測。

cues.en: So as soon as an email comes in or a text message and we want to know if it's spam or not, translation it wouldn't be that ideal if we went to Google Translate.
cues.zh: 電子郵件或簡訊一到，就想知道是不是垃圾訊息。另外是翻譯，如果使用 Google 翻譯卻得等很久，也不理想。

cues.en: So let's go to translate.
cues.zh: 來開啟 translate。

cues.en: Google.com.
cues.zh: google.com。

cues.en: This is an online machine learning model, so machine learning is fun.
cues.zh: 這是線上的機器學習模型。輸入「機器學習很好玩」。

cues.en: Let's translate that into Spanish.
cues.zh: 把它翻成西班牙文。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: El Apprentice G automatically is the title.
cues.zh: 這裡是西班牙文的「機器學習很好玩」；講者的朗讀在字幕中辨識不清。

cues.en: So excuse me to all of the people who speak Spanish out there for my mispronunciation.
cues.zh: 所有說西班牙文的朋友，請原諒我的發音。

cues.en: That's what happens when you get an Australian accent trying to talk Spanish.
cues.zh: 這就是澳洲口音嘗試說西班牙文的結果。

cues.en: Then, of course, we have a self driving vision system.
cues.zh: 當然，還有自動駕駛視覺系統。

cues.en: So it would be, again, not an ideal scenario if we had to wait 10 minutes for our self-driving car to make a prediction on what was in front of us.
cues.zh: 如果自動駕駛汽車要等十分鐘，才預測前面有什麼，那也不是理想的情況。

cues.zh: 這是我使用的資源之一，

cues.zh: 我從中學到許多模型部署的知識。

cues.zh: 找到了。

cues.en: So with that being said, we've covered how is my model going to function offline or online?
cues.zh: 到這裡，我們談了模型要如何運作：離線還是線上。

cues.en: And of course we can mix and match these just like we can mix cloud and edge.
cues.zh: 當然，可以混合搭配，就像雲端與邊緣端也能混合。

cues.en: But now, speaking of cloud and edge, what are some places or tools to help deploy machine learning models?
cues.zh: 說到雲端與邊緣端，有哪些地方或工具可以幫助部署機器學習模型？

cues.en: Let's discuss that in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一段影片來討論。
